description:
Claude Ads is a free Claude Code skill that plans, audits, and reports on paid ads across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Microsoft.

In this video I run /ads plan for a real SaaS brand (Rankenstein Pro). The agent asks about business type, budget, and goals, scrapes the site, researches competitors, and builds a full ad strategy. With a $1,000/month budget it recommends Meta-only (LinkedIn priced out, Google Search too expensive at that spend), then produces campaign architecture, a budget plan, and a designed PDF report with charts, all built on a research base of 2,500+ sources.
